title: What Our Clients Say
description: We met through one of BMI’s presentations a little over a year ago when Jim and I began exploring the potential sale of our business.  We had many questions, not having any experience in the sale of a business. They really put it in layman’s terms with what we could expect.  This lead to a more formal meeting at our place of business and they really took the time to know us and more importantly, to know our business. The whole process was amazing! From working with BMI to create the CIM to meeting with potential buyers, to receiving LOI’s, and most importantly, to help us find the right buyer that fit my late father, Jim and I’s vision on where Bardot Plastics would go into the future and, at the same time provide the right exit strategy for us and our family. Here we are, a year later. Jim and I, as well as the rest of Bardot Plastics, have much to look forward to as the business will expand and grow to create a new chapter in Bardot Plastics history. My father would be proud that his legacy will continue. For that, we are grateful. + - Rick and Jim Boucher Owner, Bardot Plastics

title: Confidential Business SalesSerious Buyers | Proven Results | Tailored Guidance
description: More Buyers – Better Offers – More Options Our extensive databases and network of strategic and financial buyers, combined with our tactics for highly synergistic opportunities, ensure maximum market access. Our marketing techniques showcase your firm’s strengths and opportunities, matching them to buyer needs. As a result, our clients receive from 5 to 15 offers, allowing them to maximize their exit value and obtain the best terms possible. Learn More About How We Connect You with Buyers > Confidential – Secure Process For Your Protection Our first priority is to protect your business. With our experience in dealing with all types of buyers, we identify and neutralize threats, and shield your employees, customers, and suppliers. All buyers are screened and required to sign a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) before identifying the client. Clients pre-approve the buyer outreach plan. The NDA includes protections for confidentiality and non-solicitation. Due diligence requests are scrutinized for necessity and potential threats. Custom Marketing Process Tailored to Your Unique Business Managing the Process: Successfully selling or acquiring a business requires focusing on every step, from initial planning to identifying qualified buyers, all the way through post-closing integration. Our experienced M&A Advisors manage the entire business sale process, allowing you to focus on running your business. This approach helps maximize business value and ensures successful transactions. There are three distinct phases comprising 15 steps: Phase I – Assessment, Valuation, Analysis of Personal Needs, Sell or Hold Decision Phase II – Marketing – Develop Marketing Book, Blind Teaser, Marketing Strategy, Buyer Prospecting, and Evaluation Phase III – Negotiating, Closing the Transaction – Letter of Intent, Deal Structure, Due Diligence, Purchase Agreement, Closing, Post-Closing Assistance Contact Us for a Confidential Conversation >
